name: getMongoService
description: Returns a MongoDB client object for the named MongoDB datasource. Call `db(name)` on the result to get a database object, and then work with its collections. Define the datasource in Application.cfc (in `this.datasources` with `type="mongodb"`) or in the ColdFusion Administrator under NoSQL Data Sources.

params.name: datasource
params.description: Name of a MongoDB datasource defined in Application.cfc or the ColdFusion Administrator.

links.title: Integrate ColdFusion and MongoDB
links.description: Adobe guide to using MongoDB datasources in ColdFusion
